title: INTERNAL — Email & Retention Draft Sequences (Not Published)
body:
STATUS: HOLD FOR OWNER APPROVAL. Nothing here has been sent to any customer. This page is unpublished and must stay unpublished. Every [BRACKET] must be filled by Masha with a real figure — lead times, box counts and assembly times are deliberately not invented.

Sequence 1 — Abandoned checkout (3 emails, no discount)

Trigger: checkout abandoned. Exit on purchase. Tool: Shopify's built-in abandoned checkout email for Email 1; Emails 2–3 need Shopify Email or Klaviyo.

Email 1 — 1 hour after abandon

Subject: Your {{product}} is still in your basket
Preview: Handmade in West Yorkshire, free UK delivery

[Return to your basket]
Free UK delivery · 5-year frame guarantee · Klarna and Clearpay available
Still deciding? Just reply — Masha reads every email.

Email 2 — 24 hours

Preview: No cost, no obligation

Choosing a bed from a screen is hard. Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé all photograph differently to how they look in your own bedroom light. So we will post you free fabric swatches — no cost, no obligation.
[Request free swatches → /pages/request-a-swatch] [Back to my basket]

Preview: Sizes, delivery and paying in instalments

1. Will it fit? Sizes: Kids Single 2ft6, Single 3ft, Small Double 4ft, Standard Double 4ft6, King 5ft, Super King 6ft. Measure your room, not your old bed.
2. What if something goes wrong? Every frame carries our 5-year guarantee.
3. Can I spread the cost? Klarna and Clearpay are available at checkout.
[Finish my order] [Ask us a question]

Every email carries one-click unsubscribe and our postal address. No discount is offered at any point — discounting a handmade made-to-order range trains people to wait for a sale.

Sequence 2 — Browse abandon (1 email)

Trigger: viewed a product, no add to cart, no order in 24h. Subscribers only. Max once per 7 days. Skip if already in the checkout sequence. Requires Klaviyo free tier — Shopify Basic + Flow cannot trigger on product views.

Delay 4 hours. Subject: Still thinking about the {{product}}?
Preview: Here's what it's actually like in the room

Hi {{first_name}}, you had a look at the {{product}} earlier. No rush — a bed is a ten-year decision.
• Handmade to order in our West Yorkshire workshop, in your choice of fabric: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy or Teddy Bouclé. Custom fabric on request.
• Free UK delivery and a 5-year guarantee on the frame.
• Klarna and Clearpay at checkout if you would rather spread it.
Not sure about the colour? We will post you free fabric swatches. [Send me free swatches]
[View the {{product}} again]
Want storage instead? Our ottoman gas-lift and side-lift bases start at £220.99. [See storage beds]
Questions about size or delivery? Reply to this email.

Sequence 3 — Post-purchase (3 emails)

Trigger: order created. Exit on refund. Shopify Flow.

Email 1 — 1 hour after order

Subject: Thanks {{first_name}} — here's exactly what happens next

Your order {{order_number}} is confirmed: {{product}}, {{size}}, {{fabric}}. Because every Eagle Bed is handmade to order: build takes [X working days], delivery takes [Y working days], so expect your bed around [DATE RANGE]. We will email tracking the moment it leaves us. On delivery day the bed arrives flat-packed in [N] boxes — please have someone able to help receive them, and measure your stairs and doorways now. Reply and we will send box dimensions. Questions any time: eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Email 2 — 1 day after delivery

Subject: Putting your {{product}} together — a quick hand

• Allow [X] minutes and two people for the headboard.
• Tighten every bolt loosely first, square the frame, then tighten fully — that is what stops a creak later.
• Ottoman owners: leave the gas struts until the frame is fully bolted.
• Fabric care: brush Plush Velvet and Teddy Bouclé with a soft brush; blot spills, never rub.
Stuck or something missing? Reply today and we will sort it — your frame is covered by our 5-year guarantee.

Email 3 — 14 days after delivery — THE ONLY REVIEW ASK

Subject: How's the {{product}} sleeping?

No problems? An honest short review genuinely helps another family choose. [Leave a review]
Something not right? Reply and we will fix it first — please give us a go before you leave a review.

Rules: one review link only, chosen by Reviews & Reputation. Suppress anyone who has already reviewed and anyone with an open support thread in the last 7 days. Never ask for a five-star review, never offer anything in exchange.

Sequence 4 — Swatch requester follow-up (3 emails)

Trigger: swatch request received (see /pages/request-a-swatch). Marketing consent required before Emails 2 and 3.

Email 1 — same day. Subject: Your Eagle Bed swatches are on the way. Body: confirms the fabrics requested, tells them to view the swatches in daylight and at night against the wall where the headboard will go, links to the ottoman, divan, wingback and kids collections, and asks which bed they are considering so we can answer sizing questions.

Email 2 — 5 days. Subject: Did your swatches arrive? Body: check they landed; one short paragraph on the practical difference between Plush Velvet, Chenille and Teddy Bouclé in a real bedroom; sizes 2ft6–6ft; free UK delivery; 5-year guarantee; Klarna and Clearpay. One link to the collection matching the bed they asked about.

Email 3 — 14 days. Subject: Any questions before you order? Body: one question — what is stopping you? — plus the three facts most people need (fit, guarantee, finance) and a single link. Then stop. No further swatch emails unless they reply.

Sequence 5 — Bed + mattress bundle upsell (1 email)

Trigger: order created for a bed frame or ottoman base with no mattress in the order, send 1 hour after Email 1 of the post-purchase sequence — or as a standalone campaign to consented subscribers.

Subject: Your bed's being built — is your mattress ready for it?
Body: Your {{product}} is in the workshop. A new frame on a tired mattress is the one thing customers tell us they regret. Our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress is made in the UK, fits every size we build, and starts at £142.99 (Single 3ft), £194.99 Standard Double 4ft6, £220.99 King 5ft, £259.99 Super King 6ft — all live store prices. Free UK delivery, Klarna and Clearpay. [See the mattress]

HANDOFF → Product Content: bundle offer logic is yours. Any bundle saving is a live price change and needs Masha's written approval first. Bundle must show the real saving against the two live prices, must not be advertised before it exists as a purchasable option, and the mattress depth/firmness facts must be verified before they go in any email.

Consent and compliance rules for all five sequences

Abandoned checkout and post-purchase emails are transactional/soft-opt-in and go only to people who entered their own address. Browse abandon, swatch follow-up Emails 2–3 and the bundle campaign require an explicit marketing opt-in. The checkout marketing consent box must never be pre-ticked. Every marketing email carries one-click unsubscribe and a postal address. No invented discounts, stock levels, urgency, delivery promises, review counts or star ratings.

title: Handmade Beds in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
body:
Last updated: 30 September 2026. Prices quoted are 'from' prices as of 30 September 2026.

Our Dewsbury Workshop: How an Eagle Bed Is Made

Eagle Bed is a British bed maker based in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. We are not a reseller or a drop-shipper: the beds we sell are upholstered to order in our own workshop, loaded onto our own van and carried to your door by our own team. This page explains what that actually means for the bed you receive, and why it is different from buying a flat-packed frame that has passed through three warehouses and a courier hub.

Where we are and what we make

Everything is made in West Yorkshire. Our range covers upholstered bed frames, gas-lift ottoman and divan storage bases, divan beds with drawers, wingback and Chesterfield designs, children's beds and UK-made pocket sprung and memory orthopaedic mattresses. Prices start from £220.99 for a Single (3FT) Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base.

  • Upholstered bed frames — panel, fluted, tufted and arch headboard designs
  • Ottoman and gas-lift storage beds — end-lift and side-lift bases
  • Divan beds with drawers — storage without lifting the mattress
  • Wingback beds and Chesterfield beds — tall, traditional silhouettes
  • Kids beds from Kids Single 2FT6
  • Mattresses — pocket sprung and memory orthopaedic, made in the UK

The frame comes first

Every Eagle Bed is built on a wooden frame. The timber structure is what carries the load of the mattress, the sleepers and, on our storage models, the contents of the base — so it is built before any fabric is cut. Foam padding is applied over the timber, and only then does the bed go to the upholstery bench. Every frame we sell is backed by our 5-year frame warranty.

Upholstered to order, not pulled off a shelf

We do not hold finished stock in every colour. When an order comes in, the fabric is cut and fitted to that specific bed. That is why you can choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, and why we can take custom fabric and colour requests that a mass-market retailer cannot.

Because colour on a screen is never the colour in your bedroom, we send free fabric swatches before you commit. Most of our customers order swatches first, live with them next to their curtains and carpet for a few days, and then buy with confidence. You can request free swatches here.

Made-to-order in every UK size

We build to the standard UK mattress sizes, so any UK mattress will fit: Kids Single 2FT6, Single 3FT, Small Double 4FT, Standard Double 4FT6, King 5FT and Super King 6FT. Because each bed is made for the order rather than picked from a pallet, the size and fabric combination you want is the one that gets built — there is no "only available in grey" compromise.

Storage: three different answers to the same problem

A large part of what we make is storage beds, and the right one depends on your room rather than your budget.

  • End-lift gas lift ottoman — the whole mattress platform lifts on hydraulic struts from the foot of the bed. Best if you have clear floor at the end of the bed. Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base, from £220.99.
  • Side-lift gas lift ottoman — the platform opens from the side, so the bed can sit against a wall at the foot. Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base, from £249.99.
  • Divan with drawers — fixed drawers built into the base, no lifting, one drawer at a time. See the Cambridge, Oxford and Sussex Panel Storage Beds, from £259.99.

Our own delivery team

Finished beds are collected from the workshop and carried to your door by our own delivery team — they are never passed through a courier hub, and they are never handled by people who have no idea what is inside the wrapping. That is the single biggest reason our beds arrive undamaged: fewer hands, fewer vans, one team that knows what it is carrying. Delivery across Great Britain is free (Northern Ireland £90).

What backs it up

  • 5-year frame warranty on every bed frame
  • Free delivery across Great Britain
  • Free fabric swatches before you buy
  • Klarna and Clearpay available at checkout
  • UK-made mattresses in every standard UK size

Why buy from the people who make it

Buying direct from a workshop means the person who answers your email can walk to the bench where your bed is being built. If you want a fabric we do not list, we can usually source it. If you are unsure whether a tall headboard will work under a sloping ceiling, we will talk it through rather than send you a returns label later. And if something does go wrong inside five years, you are dealing with the maker, not a middleman.

Frequently asked questions

Who makes handmade upholstered beds in Yorkshire?

Eagle Bed does. Our upholstered beds, gas-lift ottoman and divan storage bases, wingback and Chesterfield designs and kids beds are made to order in our own workshop in Pepproyd Street, Eastborough, Dewsbury, West Yorkshire WF13 1PA, and delivered by our own team.

Can I speak to someone before I buy?

Yes. Call 07417 439197 (Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com with your room measurements and questions, and we will help you choose a size and fabric.

Is delivery free?

Yes, across Great Britain. Northern Ireland, Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man are £90.

Start here

Browse the upholstered bed frames, the ottoman storage beds, the wingback beds, the Chesterfield beds, the kids beds or our UK-made mattresses. Not sure on colour? Order free swatches first — they cost you nothing and they save a lot of second-guessing.

Questions, trade enquiries or press: press and media information, or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

body:
INTERNAL DOCUMENT — NOT FOR SHOPPERS. Owner approval required before any email is activated or sent (Master Directive: change control). Prepared by Email & Retention, 30 Sep 2026.

1. KPI baseline — what I can and cannot see today

Benchmark to judge us against once live: a working 3-email abandoned-checkout flow typically recovers 5–12% of abandoned checkouts. Anything under 3% after 200 sends means the flow failed, not the list.

2. Consent and law (UK GDPR / PECR) — read before activating anything

  • Cart/checkout recovery to someone who started a purchase is covered by soft opt-in, provided every email carries a one-click unsubscribe and a trading address in the footer.
  • Newsletter / marketing email requires a separate, unticked opt-in box. A swatch request on its own is a service request, not marketing consent.
  • Never pre-tick a box. Never email a customer who unsubscribed. Never buy or import a list.
  • Owner must supply a postal trading address for the footer of every template — this is a legal requirement, not a design choice.
  • No invented discounts, urgency, stock levels or delivery dates. Only facts already published on the site: handmade in West Yorkshire, 5-year guarantee, free UK delivery, free fabric swatches, Klarna and Clearpay.

3. Flow A — abandoned checkout (3 emails)

Platform: Shopify Email (free to 10,000 sends/month on Basic). Trigger: checkout started, not completed. Exit condition: order placed.

A1 — 1 hour after abandonment

Subject: Your Eagle Bed is still in your basket

[Finish my order] Questions? Reply to this email or write to eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

A3 — 72 hours

Preview: Reply and a real person answers
Body: Hi {{ first_name }}, if something stopped you — size, fabric, mattress fit or delivery timing — just reply to this email and we will answer. [Return to my basket] [Order free swatches]

Footer on all three: Eagle Bed, handmade in West Yorkshire. Unsubscribe | eaglebedofficial@gmail.com | [trading address — owner to supply].

How we would know it failed: recovery under 3% after 200 sends, or unsubscribe rate above 0.5%. Number to watch: recovered checkouts per 30 days.

4. Flow B — post-purchase (5 emails)

Trigger: order paid. No delivery date is to be stated until Product Content supplies the lead time in working days; until then use “we will email you the moment your bed leaves our workshop”.

PP1 — immediately after order

PP2 — 1 day after order: mattress cross-sell (bed and base buyers only)

If you are replacing the mattress too, both of ours are built to the same UK sizes: the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress from £220.99 and the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress from £142.99, both made in the UK with a 5-year guarantee. Order before dispatch and we can send it with your bed. [Shop mattresses]

PP3 — on dispatch

PP4 — 7 days after delivery: care guide

Subject: Looking after your {{ product }}
Links to the live care guide at /blogs/news/how-to-care-for-an-upholstered-bed-and-mattress plus the 5-year guarantee terms and how to claim.

PP5 — 21 days after delivery: review request

Subject: How is your Eagle Bed?
Hi {{ first_name }}, three weeks in — how is it? A short honest review helps other people choose. [Leave a review] Not right? Reply and we will sort it. Hand-off: Reviews & Reputation owns the review destination and the reply templates.

How we would know it failed: PP5 under 5% review rate, or PP2 producing zero mattress attachments in 30 orders. Numbers to watch: mattress attach rate; reviews collected per month.

5. Flow C — free swatch sequence and welcome

Capture point: the Request a Swatch page, plus a pop-up (Store Designer to build, owner to approve) at 25 seconds or exit intent — “Not sure about the fabric? We will post you free swatches.” Fields: first name, email, postal address. Separate, unticked box: “Email me Eagle Bed news and new arrivals.”

S1 — instant: “Your free swatches are on the way.” Confirm the fabrics requested and link back to the bed being considered.
S2 — day 4: “Have your swatches arrived?” One line per fabric — plush velvet (soft, rich colour), chenille (hard-wearing, textured), Coniston, Naples, Galaxy, Teddy bouclé (cosy, modern). Custom fabric on request.
S3 — day 8: “Ready to choose?” Link the exact bed viewed, the size range (Kids Single 2ft6 to Super King 6ft) and the Klarna/Clearpay note. Invite a reply.

W1 — welcome (opted-in subscribers only): who we are — handmade in West Yorkshire, 5-year guarantee, free UK delivery, free swatches — plus links to the Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base (from £220.99), Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base (from £249.99), Mirror Strip Sunrise Bed (from £285.99) and Line Kids Velvet Bed (from £285.99).

6. Flow D — win-back (prepare, do not send yet)

Audience: customers 9+ months past delivery, and swatch requesters who never ordered. Angle is a second bedroom, a child moving to a bigger bed, or a mattress upgrade — never a fake discount. Hold until the abandoned-checkout flow has 30 days of data, so we are not testing two things at once.

7. Escalations to other departments

  • Store Designer (P0): 0.15% checkout completion. Email recovers people who reach checkout; it cannot fix why almost nobody does.
  • Product Content: ottoman storage depth in cm, headboard heights, mattress depth and delivery lead time in working days. No email may state these until supplied.
  • Reviews & Reputation: owns the review destination that PP5 links to.
  • Shopping Feed / Store Designer: any product with unusually high abandonment gets a price and delivery check.

title: Ottoman & Gas Lift Storage Beds: The UK Buyer's Guide
body:
Ottoman beds are the most space-efficient way to add hidden storage to a UK bedroom, but the buying decision is rarely explained properly: side lift or end lift, how much space you actually gain, what size fits the room, and whether drawers would suit you better. This guide answers those questions using nothing but the beds we build ourselves in West Yorkshire, with the real prices and the real UK mattress sizes.

What is an ottoman (gas lift) bed?

An ottoman bed is a divan-style base where the entire mattress platform lifts on hydraulic gas struts, opening a storage compartment that runs the full footprint of the bed. You don't take the mattress off — the struts carry its weight as the platform swings up on a hinge. A standard divan, by contrast, either has fixed pull-out drawers or no storage at all.

Side lift or end lift? Decide by the wall, not the price

This is the single decision most buyers get wrong, and it is decided by your room layout rather than by preference.

  • End lift — the platform hinges at the headboard and lifts from the foot of the bed. Choose it when you have clear floor space at the foot. This is our Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base, from £220.99 (Single 3ft) to £363.99 (Super King 6ft).
  • Side lift — the platform hinges along one long side. Choose it when the foot of the bed sits against a wall, in an alcove, or facing a radiator or wardrobe, and you have clear floor down one side instead. This is our Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base, from £249.99 (Single 3ft) to £394.99 (Super King 6ft).

Both lift the full mattress platform, both take any standard UK mattress, and both need headroom above the bed for the platform to swing open. In a box room, the side lift is usually the one that still works after the furniture is in.

The box-room test: three questions before you order

  1. Where does the foot of the bed end up? Against a wall or a radiator → side lift. Open floor → end lift, which is also the lower-priced option.
  2. Which side of the bed has clear floor? A side lift needs that clear side to open into. Measure it before ordering, and leave at least 60cm walking space on at least one side of the bed.
  3. How much headroom is above the mattress? Sloped ceilings, loft conversions and low windows restrict how far the platform can swing up. If headroom is the problem, drawers are the better answer — see the comparison below.

How much storage do you actually gain?

An ottoman opens up the whole area under the mattress, so the usable area tracks the UK mattress size you choose. The table below gives the standard UK mattress dimensions we build to and the resulting platform footprint. Treat the footprint as the outer figure: the internal compartment is smaller once the base construction is allowed for.

Size UK mattress size Platform footprint End lift from Side lift from
Single 3ft — 90 x 190cm approx. 1.71 m² £220.99 £249.99
Small Double 4ft — 120 x 190cm approx. 2.28 m² £253.99 £274.99
Standard Double 4ft6 — 135 x 190cm approx. 2.57 m² £272.99 £284.99
King 5ft — 150 x 200cm approx. 3.00 m² £305.99 £334.99
Super King 6ft — 180 x 200cm approx. 3.60 m² £363.99 £394.99

Ottoman, drawers or plain frame?

Option How you get to the storage Best for From
Gas lift ottoman — end lift Whole platform lifts from the foot Most storage; clear floor at the foot of the bed £220.99
Gas lift ottoman — side lift Whole platform lifts from the side Box rooms and beds set foot-to-wall £249.99
Ottoman with matching headboard Gas lift base plus upholstered bumper headboard Buyers who want base and headboard as one finished look £324.99
Divan with drawers Fixed pull-out drawers Low ceilings, or anyone who doesn't want to lift £259.99
Plain upholstered frame No built-in storage; standard under-bed boxes fit Rooms where storage is already sorted £285.99

Browse the full range on our ottoman beds, storage beds with drawers and divan beds pages.

Gas strut safety checklist

Gas struts are safe and well proven, but they are under pressure and deserve a little respect. Run through this before and after you assemble a storage bed:

  • Assemble the base on a level floor. An out-of-square base makes the platform bind and puts uneven load on the struts.
  • Fit both struts the same way up, following the instructions supplied with your base — struts are directional.
  • Lift and lower the platform with the mattress on. Struts are matched to carry the mattress weight; testing it bare will feel abruptly light.
  • Lift with one hand on the platform, not on the mattress cover, and let the strut take over — never yank it.
  • Guide the platform down with your hand; never let it drop under its own weight.
  • Keep children and pets clear of the open compartment, and never leave the platform open and unattended.
  • Don't store anything that props against the hinge side or stands taller than the base — it will foul the platform as it closes.
  • Check the strut fixings once a year. If a platform starts sinking on its own or feels heavy to lift, stop using it and contact us — every Eagle Bed base carries a 5-year warranty.

Mattress depth and how it affects the lift

Gas struts are rated for the weight they carry, and your mattress is most of that weight. A deeper, heavier mattress makes the platform feel firmer to open and lighter to close; a very light mattress does the opposite. Our ottoman bases take any standard UK mattress, and our own 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress (from £220.99) and Memory Orthopaedic Mattress (from £142.99) are both built in the UK to the same five sizes as the bases. If you are replacing a mattress on an existing ottoman, keep the new one close to the old one in depth and weight so the lift behaves as it did before.

Buying checklist

  • Measure the wall, the floor in front, and the side you'd open from — in that order.
  • Check headroom if you're under a slope or a low window.
  • Decide side lift vs end lift from the layout, not the price.
  • Choose your UK size from the table above — our sizes run Kids Single 2ft6, Single 3ft, Small Double 4ft, Standard Double 4ft6, King 5ft and Super King 6ft.
  • Order free fabric swatches before committing to a colour.

About Eagle Bed

We are a small bed maker in West Yorkshire. Every bed on this site is handmade to order in plush velvet, chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy or Teddy bouclé — custom fabrics on request — and comes with a 5-year warranty, free delivery across Great Britain and free fabric swatches. Klarna and Clearpay are available at checkout. Questions about storage sizes, fabrics or delivery: eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

title: UK Bed Size Guide — Dimensions in cm and feet
body:
UK bed sizes in centimetres, feet and inches

UK bed sizes are quoted in old imperial names (4ft6, 5ft) but sold in metric mattress dimensions. A UK Double is 135 x 190cm, a UK King is 150 x 200cm — and neither matches the American or European sizes of the same name, which is the single most common reason a mattress turns up and does not fit. Below is every size Eagle Bed makes, with the mattress dimensions and the floor space the bed actually needs.

Full UK bed size chart

Size name Imperial Mattress size (cm) Mattress size (inches) Who it suits
Kids Single 2ft6 75 x 190cm 30" x 75" Children moving out of a cot bed; narrow box rooms
Single 3ft 90 x 190cm 36" x 75" One sleeper, children's rooms, guest rooms
Small Double 4ft 120 x 190cm 48" x 75" One adult who wants more room, or couples in a small second bedroom
Standard Double 4ft6 135 x 190cm 54" x 75" The standard UK couple's bed
King 5ft 150 x 200cm 60" x 78" Couples wanting more width and 10cm extra length
Super King 6ft 180 x 200cm 72" x 78" Taller sleepers, couples who want maximum space, larger master bedrooms

These are UK standard mattress sizes. The outer dimensions of a bed frame are always larger than the mattress, because the frame, upholstery and side rails sit around it, and they vary by model. If you need an exact external measurement before ordering, email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com with the model and size and we will confirm it.

How much floor space does the bed need?

  • Leave at least 60cm of walking space down at least one side of the bed. Two people sharing ideally want 60cm on both sides.
  • Measure the wall first, not the room. The wall the headboard sits against is the measurement that decides whether a 150cm King fits with space for bedside tables.
  • Check ceiling slopes, low windows and radiators before choosing a tall headboard such as a wingback or extra-tall panel bed.
  • Check the route in: doorways, stair turns and landing width. Measure the narrowest point.
  • Storage beds need clearance too. A drawer divan needs clear floor in front of the drawer side; a gas lift ottoman needs headroom above the bed so the platform can swing open.

Choosing between two sizes

If you are between a Small Double (120cm) and a Standard Double (135cm), the deciding factor is usually bedside furniture, not the bed — the 15cm you save is often what lets a bedside table fit. Between a Double (135 x 190cm) and a King (150 x 200cm), remember the King is also 10cm longer, which matters if anyone sleeping in it is over about 6ft tall. Bedding is sized to these standards too, so a Small Double needs Small Double bedding, not Double.

UK sizes are not US or EU sizes

A US King is 193 x 203cm, wider and longer than a UK King at 150 x 200cm. A US Queen is 152 x 203cm, close to a UK King in width but longer. European mattresses are commonly 200cm long and sold in 140cm, 160cm and 180cm widths. If you buy a frame abroad or online from a non-UK seller, UK mattresses and UK bedding may not fit it. Every Eagle Bed frame, base and mattress is built to UK standard sizes, so they fit each other and fit UK bedding.

Shop by what you need

  • Storage in a small room: Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base (from £249.99) opens from the side, so the foot of the bed can sit against a wall.
  • Maximum storage: Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base (from £220.99), end-opening, the whole platform lifts.
  • Drawers instead of lifting: Cambridge Panel Storage Bed (from £259.99).
  • Statement headboard: Hilton Wingback Bed (from £337.99).
  • Matching mattress: 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress (from £220.99) or the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress (from £142.99), both made in the UK in Single 3ft to Super King 6ft.
